svg.title: Debugging and observing the device over PCIe
svg.desc: On the host, GDB talks the remote serial protocol to a debug service in the process that owns the device, or to the standalone tsr-dbg; the service and the profiling and log tools use tsr_transport, which reaches the core CSR window over PCIe. In the window: the DMI at 0xC00 leads to the RISC-V debug module, the Ibex control core (halt, step, breakpoints) and the system bus access to the TCMs and the SPM; the DBG block at 0x800 to 0xAFC holds the stop logic for the queue heads, the 512-entry dispatch history and the unit probes; the log ring, the performance counters and the trace writer to a DRAM ring serve observation. All of it is planned.
